verdict.rationale: Clerk ships a first-party remote MCP server whose account tools let AI agents create and configure applications, manage users and set up production instances, so the product can be operated through natural-language requests in AI clients like Claude, Cursor and Copilot. The CLI can connect that MCP server in one command. However, the natural-language layer comes from the external AI client rather than a native interface, and the account-tool scope is described in only a single line. missing for 10: a native natural-language interface in the product or dashboard, detailed documentation of which operations the account tools cover, independent hands-on corroboration of operating Clerk via natural language.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Account tools: Create and configure applications, manage users, and set up production instances in your Clerk workspace.
Clerk provides a remote Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that allows AI agents like Claude, Cursor, and Github Copilot to access Clerk SDK snippets and implementation patterns.
Connect the Clerk MCP server to your AI clients in one command
